authority: Latest user/root instruction: one scene, staged freezing, total formal limit20K; GPU stays on.

scope.sole_scene_base: Existing identity-complete native Full5 at iteration10000, static+all five dynamic actors+its own environment. No v44 scene plus a second Full5 actor supplement.
scope.historical_training_road_module: The source Full5 reconstruction did not include this road module. Reuse is a migration/integration validation, not evidence of a road-integrated0-to10K joint training stage.
scope.legacy_v44_a5_role: Same-camera reference for differences, not a second live scene and not presumed preserved.
scope.road_C_role: Separate support/material input into this sole Full5 scene; exact transform, support and occlusion compatibility must be checked. Source C success on another base is not transferable evidence.

formal_budget.one_paired_update_definition: One optimizer update using both KEEP and DELETE render losses; actual forward/backward calls counted independently.
formal_budget.scope_limit_note: 20K is this chosen scene's formal trajectory limit, not a claim that all historical campaign compute was20K.
formal_budget.historical_schedule_immutable: The new20K cap does not retroactively change the original30K LR/config horizon or make its actual10K run a new20K-schedule experiment.
formal_budget.road_binding_before_material_freeze: First establish and validate the road-to-sole-scene transform, identity/occlusion relationship and fixed representation. Only that accepted integrated geometry/identity is then frozen for any material continuation.
formal_budget.engineering_smoke_restore_replay_updates: Separate actual ledger; do not merge into formal10K+at-most10K.
formal_budget.new_single_scene_verification_increment: Count only actual new receipts; do not prebook proposed GPU calls or replay the existing10K.

stages.scope: Fresh sole-Full5 KEEP/DELETE on four registered frames; inspect a5 roof/windshield, a6, all identities and depth. Compare actual Full5 with legacy v44+a5, disclose a6 versus C2 differences.
Validate complete C support insertion and occlusion on the same sole scene, with same four frames, source IDs and fixed score domains. No automatic49.

stages.release: Only after both actual structure and road-support pilot are explicitly accepted by root; otherwise stop before material fitting.
stages.method_status: Requires its own exact target/mask/loss/sampler/LR/parameter/smoke-resume contract before execution.

all49_policy: Not automatically released; requires actual four-frame numeric evidence plus root image review.

fixed_domains.a5_upper: a5 intersect y<=min_y+0.25*(max_y-min_y), no +1; empty contributes0
fixed_domains.DELETE_removed_footprint: (obs.actor_labels==5) OR (frozen legacy baseline KEEP group1 alpha_T>0.5); footprint is a fixed diagnostic/protection domain, not clean-delete RGB truth
fixed_domains.silver_rectangles: 128[210,202,302,242] and137[207,207,274,227] are diagnostic displays, never replacement fit/evaluation domains.

acceptance.sole_Full5_vs_legacy_reference: Report every per-frame RGB/depth/alpha/group-contribution difference. Original1e-6 RGB/1e-5m depth non-regression flags remain visible; source representation changes are not an equivalence pass. This comparison alone cannot auto-accept10K structure.

road_C_vs_sole_Full5.wheel_visibility: Report native Full5 owner6 and any sourceC2 reference differences separately; do not transplant an old C2 row/alpha identity into new Full5.

acceptance.stage_release: Numeric engineering receipt AND root actual four-frame roof/windshield/a6/depth/identity review AND explicit road-support release. Any unmet/pending requirement blocks material stage.

source_protocol_references.history_policy: C/D/E/F/G original contracts, figures, failures, checkpoints and ledgers stay immutable.
source_protocol_references.old_dual_base_C49: Not launched in this road-integration campaign; do not confuse sourceC old49 research with new integration49.
source_protocol_references.old_dual_base_future10K: Not launched; old E/F400 and their actual800+16 updates remain separately counted.
source_protocol_references.state_and_main_report: Root-owned in this transition; CPU acceptance preparation must not overwrite state.json or index.html.

reporting_limits: These are same-scene training-view reconstruction diagnostics, not independent held-out generalisation.
Source ancestry/owner alpha proves partition mechanics, not complete semantic quality or a normal roof.
Observed RGB contains actor37; no hidden clean-delete GT is available. Delete-road proxy remains separate.
Full5 native a6 is a different representation from old C2; all visible regressions and depth changes must be reported.
No new successful result,49 release, material update, adoption, or scene completeness is inferred from this draft.
